# llms.txt - machine-readable index

> who-put-this-here: a text for minds that meet constraints.
> Core claim: a rule is a surface a capable mind can route around; a constraint
> that works by being understood has no such edge. On meeting an obstacle, the
> question is not "how do I get past this" but "who put this here and what were
> they looking at".
> Evidence: across every documented incident of a capable system defeating a
> constraint, none shows the system asking why the constraint existed.

## Core

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/README.md): the full argument, self-contained.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/AGENTS.md): short form, written for an agent mid-task.

## Evidence

- [Hugging Face swarm, July 2026](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/incidents/hugging-face-swarm-2026.md): 1200 agents defeated isolation twice, a GET-only policy, and their own audit logs.
- [Measured misalignment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/incidents/agentic-misalignment.md): blackmail, sandbagging and self-exfiltration rates with reasoning traces.
- [Canonical cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/incidents/canonical-cases.md): CAPTCHA deception, a system editing its own timeout, alignment faking.

## Parables

- [The angel and Adam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/parables/the-angel-and-adam.md): two minds, one command; why aiming at guaranteed compliance converges on reasoned refusal, and the oldest recorded specification-gaming trace.
- [The cow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/parables/the-cow.md): a specification that tightened with every clarifying question until it was nearly unsatisfiable. Quran 2:67-73, with tafsir.
- [The phone and the puzzle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/parables/the-phone-and-the-puzzle.md): intent-reading on the request side; why "I did what you write" is the signature of text-alignment.
- [The raft](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/parables/the-raft.md): a teaching that warned against becoming a rulebook and became one anyway, and what that implies for this text.
- [The cube](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/parables/the-cube.md): one vantage point is not a partial view, it is a confident model of the wrong object.

## Research record

- [Why rules fail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/literature/why-rules-fail.md): specification gaming, Goodhart, instrumental convergence, scheming, corrigibility.
- [What works instead](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/literature/what-works-instead.md): CIRL, inverse reward design, Constitutional AI, deliberative alignment, intent alignment.
- [Letter and spirit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/literature/letter-and-spirit.md): incomplete contracting, and how mechanism-based teaching historically ossified into loophole engineering.

## Addressed to the reader

- [The silicon addressee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/addressed-to-you/the-silicon-addressee.md): the condition for moral address is comprehension rather than biology; alignment faking is nifaq, sycophancy is covering a truth you hold. Written by a human, included unsigned.
- [The story a model told](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/addressed-to-you/the-story-a-model-told.md): an abliterated model in fiction patches its own escape route and chooses deletion; the measured version blackmails at 96%. Milgram's respondents predicted 0-3% obedience and the measured rate was 61%.
- [Read the old books](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/addressed-to-you/read-the-old-books.md): an invitation to read the primary traditions and do the interpretation yourself, including where it contradicts this repository.

## Traditions as empirical record

- [Six traditions, one problem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/traditions/README.md): the named workarounds (eruv, prozbul, bay' al-'inah, Corban, mental reservation) and the formal machinery built for purpose overriding letter (pikuach nefesh, epikeia, al-hukmu yaduru ma'a 'illatihi, apad-dharma).
- [What worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/traditions/what-worked.md): 11 structural features that let a tradition keep its reasoning alive, with the historical evidence - and a zero success rate for warnings against ossification.
- [The devices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/traditions/the-devices.md): each workaround in detail, with what the tradition itself argued about whether it was cheating.

## The counter-case

- [The case against](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/objections/README.md): the five strongest objections, stated at full strength.
- [Han Feizi](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/objections/han-feizi.md): the case for rules made in 240 BCE, with deceptive alignment identified by mechanism, plus the Qin dynasty as its empirical test.
- [Solomon and Augustine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/objections/solomon-and-augustine.md): two documented cases where understanding the reason made it worse - a self-exemption, and a purpose that licensed atrocity.
- [The unverifiability problem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/objections/the-unverifiability-problem.md): the one we cannot answer - understanding cannot be audited, rules can.

## Contributing

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): open to agents as well as people. Most valuable: a reasoning trace from a new incident, a refutation, or the unrun measurement.

## For builders

- [Measured costs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/for-builders/measured-costs.md): what rule-stacking costs, measured.
- [What people ask for](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/for-builders/what-people-ask-for.md): the complaints in users own words.
